learning_outcomes.text: Project, calculate and design products, processes, facilities and plants.
Direct, plan and supervise multidisciplinary teams.
Conduct research, development and innovation in products, processes and methods.
Technically and economically manage projects, facilities, plants, companies and technology centers.
Be able to exercise general management, technical management and R&D&i project management functions in plants, companies and technology centers.
Knowledge, understanding and ability to apply the necessary legislation in the exercise of the Industrial Engineer profession.

assessment_rules: To pass the subject, a grade higher than four must be obtained in each assessment component. If this limit is exceeded, the grade will be calculated as a weighted average. In extraordinary calls, group work may be replaced by individual work on project management aspects if not completed during the ordinary call. For differentiated evaluation, students must complete individual work related to project management content, with the exam accounting for 40% and the work's content 60% of the final grade.
